name: Dylan Mulick
bio: Dylan Mulick served as an executive for writer/EP Rob Weiss (Entourage, How To Make It In America, Ballers), developing and producing film, TV and digital projects. They were producers on the feature film, Vandal (2021). Dylan’s critically acclaimed graphic novel, NVRLND, is released on Michael Bay’s 451 Media. He wrote for the FaceBook Watch series, The Birch, and EPed and directed, An Interview, a documentary series with Norman Reedus and photographer Patrick Hoelck featuring Diane Kruger, Zachary Quinto, Liv Tyler and Peter Sarsgaard, among others. Dylan wrote and directed the award-winning Olympic documentary HELEN|BELIEVE (2025) with Religion of Sports and Chris Pratt’s Indivisible. He is the co-creator and showrunner of World Within Studios and Religion of Sports' series How To Change The World and is in post production as writer, director and producer on the NBA documentary, FLY: The Spud Webb Story. Dylan is the CCO at World Within Studios where he oversees the development, production and release slate. He recently served as EP on Netflix’s Makayla’s Voice (Academy Award shortlist) and the SXSW winning documentary, Shuffle. He claims to be a charter member of The Criterion Channel. Dylan is represented by Alex Creasia at Navigation for film and TV.
